audit_question: Does the pinned published PHP implementation calculate its stated PPN timing statistic, and how do explicit corrections change it?
included_analyses: Original implementation, one-assignment repair and independent direct stated rule
Original-label sequence comparisons and descriptive era/gap adjustment
All adjacent-pair timing and serialized nonce-byte checks
Separately cited removal of labels 24504, 35573 and 35599; main labels unchanged

excluded_analyses.alternative_classification_models: No Bitquery or other independently supplied classifier is evaluated; the principal audit holds the published labels fixed.
excluded_analyses.full_extranonce_reconstruction: Headers do not contain the complete mining-reward transaction data used by earlier ExtraNonce analyses.
excluded_analyses.miner_identity_and_causal_mechanisms: No miner identity, mining pause or timestamp-manipulation mechanism is independently established.
excluded_analyses.full_transaction_validation: Header-chain validation does not revalidate every transaction or script.
excluded_analyses.historical_receiving_clocks: The historical receiving-node clocks required to reconstruct future-time acceptance are not available.

review_scope: Computational verification; no external human peer-review endorsement or original-author confirmation is claimed.
priority_scope: The retained prior-art search is bounded and does not establish worldwide priority.
